role: Everything in this stage is dated 2026-08-03 and lives in the project's proof-note pipeline, not (yet) in Lean: mathematical proof notes accepted under the campaign's adversarial-verification bar, and sealed, preregistered numeric batteries. An 'accepted' note has survived that bar: consecutive clean hostile passes by verifiers reading in fresh contexts, at least two different model families among them, with every failed pass, every erratum, and every acceptance recorded and dated in the repository. The object of study is the carry cocycle: at each depth of the wild classifier tower, every eligible index carries an anchor monomial, and the leading value of a product of anchors differs from the anchor of the sum by an explicit correction. The laws below say this correction is one monomial with exponents given by one integer recursion, at every depth probed, and that modulo a single honest top carry the whole correction is a gauge artifact of the epsilon-chain normalization. All of it lives on a pinned model class (the standard-lift harness towers); the weld to the classifier's actual Okutsu–Montes objects is one of the displayed open items.
oneLiner: One carry law at every depth of the wild tower — proved at depths 2–3, measured through depth 6, composed for all orders, with the exact remaining distance displayed.

nodes.title: The carry cocycle: what fails to multiply, exactly
nodes.math: Fix a tower of $n{+}1$ Newton-polygon reads $(e_j, h_j, \psi_j)$, $j = 0,\dots,n$, with $\gcd(e_j,h_j)=1$, over a residue field — the model of one depth-$(n{+}1)$ branch of the classifier, with each stage lifted to the next by the canonical $\varepsilon$-corrected lift (the 'standard-lift harness tower class'). Each eligible index $\gamma$ carries an anchor monomial $\varphi_\gamma$ with a leading value $\mathrm{val}(\varphi_\gamma)$. The carry cocycle is $c_{n+1}(\gamma,\gamma') = \mathrm{val}(\varphi_\gamma\varphi_{\gamma'})/\mathrm{val}(\varphi_{\gamma+\gamma'})$ — the exact correction by which anchor values fail to be multiplicative in the index. It satisfies the 2-cocycle (associativity) identity and descends to $\mathbb{Z}/E_{n+1}$, $E_{n+1} = e_0\cdots e_n$; the deeper transport laws of the tower factor through it. The class is a model: a pinned calculus, consumed as a definition (code of record, not prose), faithful to the classifier's shape — reads, growing residue fields, digit carries.
nodes.note: This is the object the whole stage is about. Wildness lives here: at a tame prime the tower has one read and the cocycle is trivial; at a wild prime the tower is deep and the cocycle records how digit overflow at one level feeds every level below it.

nodes.title: The depth-2 law (ITER-LAW): proved, accepted 2026-08-03
nodes.math: On the standard-lift harness tower class with two reads: $c(\gamma,\gamma') = \bar z^{\,\delta_2}\, z_1^{D}$ with the top carry $\delta_2 = \lfloor (s_2(\gamma)+s_2(\gamma'))/e_1 \rfloor \in \{0,1\}$ and $D = \big(s_1(\gamma)+s_1(\gamma')-s_1(\gamma+\gamma') + \ell_0\,\gamma_2\,\delta_2\big)/e_0 \in \mathbb{Z}$, where $(\ell_0,\ell_0')$ is the normalized Bézout pair of the inner read and $\gamma_2 = e_1 w_1\Phi_1 + h_1$. Proved as a finite-algebra identity — carry-1 bookkeeping at both levels plus a two-line Bézout kernel; integrality of $D$, the 2-cocycle identity, the $\mathbb{Z}/E_2$ descent, and both one-level degenerations are displayed corollaries of the same computation.
nodes.note: Accepted 2026-08-03 at the two-clean model-diverse bar. Scope as accepted: the harness tower class, standard-lift. Residuals, in force at every use: the lift-normalization law (ITER-LAW-LIFT) is open exactly at $g_0 = 1 \wedge \delta_1 = 1$; a semantics wrapper rides a separately accepted retarget; depths ≥ 3 are untouched by this note. The sealed falsifier battery was re-run byte-exact at acceptance: 35,232 checks, zero violations.

nodes.title: The depth-3 law: proved, accepted 2026-08-03 off one displayed corner
nodes.math: On 3-read standard-lift towers: $c_3(\gamma,\gamma') = \bar z^{\,\delta_3}\, z_2^{D_2}\, z_1^{D_1}$ with $\delta_3 = \lfloor (s_3(\gamma)+s_3(\gamma'))/e_2 \rfloor$, $D_2 = \big(s_2\text{-defect} + \ell_1\gamma_3\delta_3\big)/e_1$, composed inner shift $\Sigma = D_2\gamma_2 + \delta_3\gamma_3(\ell_1' - \ell_1 w_1\Phi_1)$, and $D_1 = \big(s_1\text{-defect} + \ell_0\Sigma\big)/e_0$ — each 'defect' being $s_j(\gamma)+s_j(\gamma')-s_j(\gamma+\gamma')$. Proved on the class OFF the corner DCX $= \{g_0 = g_1 = 1,\ \delta_1 = 1,\ s_2(\gamma) = s_2(\gamma') = e_1{-}1,\ S_1 + s(\gamma_2) \ge 2e_0\}$, which is empty whenever $e_0 \le 2$. On the corner the display remains a named open lemma, (W-MULT-3-DCX), instance-true in all 132 probed cases. Before the proof, the law was found and pinned by five decorrelated numeric methods (sealed battery, independent reimplementation, from-data symbolic fit, cohomological probe, degeneration ladder) with zero splits — roughly 133,000 field-exact samples, zero violations; the naive per-level template was refuted beyond appeal (it fails associativity wherever it separates).

nodes.title: The ε-chain gauge: one normalization, one honest carry
nodes.math: The mechanism behind the laws is simpler than the laws. Modulo the single top carry, the entire cocycle is an explicit coboundary: $c_{n+1} = \bar z^{\,\delta}\cdot\partial F_n$ with $F_n(\gamma) = \prod_{j=1}^n \varepsilon_j(\beta_j(\gamma))$ — one explicitly computable unit per level, the $\varepsilon$-chain. Normalize every anchor by its $\varepsilon$-chain and multiplication becomes exact except for one carry at the top of the tower, inflated from $\mathbb{Z}/e_n$; all the recursion's constants ($D_j$, the composed shifts) are the exponent bookkeeping of $\partial F_n$. The only gauge-independent content is the top carry and one invariant class, $\mathrm{class}(c_{n+1}) = \big[\prod_j z_{j+1}^{(e_0\cdots e_{j-1})\ell_j}\big]$. The all-orders strategy of record follows: per level, prove L6-$(n)$ (anchor value $=$ $\varepsilon$-chain — routine) and W-MULT-$(n)$ (products develop with exactly the top carry — the one hard step); the closed form, integrality, cocycle identity, and the recursion are then derived corollaries, never guessed constant-by-constant again.
nodes.note: At depths 2 and 3 this reading is part of the accepted proofs. As an all-orders mechanism it is the strategy of record, converged on by five decorrelated numeric methods with zero splits (convergence judgment dated 2026-08-03); its per-level presentation $K[u]/(u^{E} - \sigma)$ visibly echoes the formalized carry algebra $F[u]/(u^e - \bar z)$ of the previous stage — that identification is conjecture-grade and is part of the open weld below.

The gauge form (equivalent, proven-equal-on-instance, to the closed form):

  c_{n+1}(γ,γ′) = z̄^{δ} · ∂F_n,   F_n(γ) = ∏_{j=1}^{n} ε_j(β_j(γ))

  invariant class:  class(c_{n+1}) = [∏_{j=0}^{n} z_{j+1}^{(e₀⋯e_{j−1})·ℓ_j}]  in  M/M^{E_{n+1}}

Strategy of record: two lemma families per level —
  L6-(n):     val_n(φ_γ) = ∏_j ε_j(β_j(γ))            [routine]
  W-MULT-(n): val_n(φ_γφ_{γ′}) = z̄^{δ} · val_n(φ_γ) · val_n(φ_{γ′})   [the hard step]

nodes.title: The all-orders theorem (ITER-LAW-n): composed, generic layers proved, NOT yet accepted
nodes.math: One recursion for every depth: top carry $\delta = \lfloor(s_{n+1}(\gamma)+s_{n+1}(\gamma'))/e_n\rfloor$, then $S_n = \delta\gamma_{n+1}$ and, for $j = n,\dots,1$: $D_j = (s_j\text{-defect} + \ell_{j-1}S_j)/e_{j-1} \in \mathbb{Z}$, $S_{j-1} = D_j\gamma_j + S_j(\ell_{j-1}' - \ell_{j-1}w_{j-1}\Phi_{j-1})$; then $c_{n+1} = \bar z^{\,\delta}\, z_n^{D_n}\cdots z_1^{D_1}$. Stated at every rung $n \ge 1$ and proved by induction on the rung, on an honest perimeter: proved level-generic are the integer cascade (integrality, positivity, window, slotwise cocycle, descent), the exponent kit, the anchor-equals-ε-chain family L6-$(n)$ from the accepted base alone, and the multiplication law's main case; the remaining cases close modulo the engine family (RM-$(n{-}1)$), off the per-level excluded corners DCX-$(n)$ (outer bound proved, sharp at the first level).

nodes.title: The semantic weld: from the model class to the actual classifier — open
nodes.math: Every accepted law in this stage lives on the standard-lift harness tower class — a pinned model calculus with the classifier's shape. The weld is the missing theorem identifying harness towers, their anchors, and their carry data with the actual Okutsu–Montes types of the formalized classifier, so that the accepted laws transport to the Lean OM tree and ultimately to the density campaign's transition expressions. Its Lean-facing counterpart is the standing order-$\ge 2$ classifier-faithfulness obligation of the formal development. The suspected dictionary — the gauge-invariant class presented as $K[u]/(u^{E}-\sigma)$ matching the formalized carry algebra $F[u]/(u^e - \bar z)$ — is recorded at conjecture grade.
nodes.note: Until this weld is proved, 'proved on the model class' is the precise strength of every accepted law above — no more is claimed anywhere on this page.

nodes.title: The read functional corrected at source (the FGMN re-derivation) — accepted
nodes.math: A standing question about the engine's read functional was answered at the source. Two compiled obstruction walls (a parity wall and a landing wall) had blocked the glue step of the paper-derived read functional inside the formalization. A from-source re-derivation at transcription scale — re-deriving the functional clause by clause from the cited print rather than from the project's own earlier transcription — delivered the verdict: the glue step does fire at the source; both walls were transcription artifacts of one doubly-scaled clause. The repair is three tokens (a weight field read one stage too late, at three sites of the definitions layer), applied under a separately gated unit with its own post-application hostile pass; the fixed points of the diff — the sites whose semantics the repair must not change — are part of the accepted record.
nodes.note: Accepted in the first days of August 2026 after a fourteen-pass, ten-revision adversarial arc with three independently executed computational legs (passes 3, 9, and 12) and a model-diverse double-clean finish. This closed, end-to-end, the campaign's longest-running repair account.
nodes.gate: Not machine-checked as a whole: the acceptance covers the two-scale diagnosis, the source-fires verdict, the exact three-token diff, and the pinned battery record; the applied diff itself compiles green in the Lean corpus.

nodes.title: The last banked unproved statement, proved outright — the corpus at zero banked
nodes.math: Since July 2026 the Lean corpus carried exactly one banked unproved statement: a Newton-polygon hull-stability bound in the classifier, off the capstone path. The statement: for finite point sets $S, S'$, if every genuine vertex of $S'$ is a point of $S$, every point of $S$ lies weakly above the $S'$-hull, and every $S$-abscissa occurs among the $S'$-abscissas, then the genuine vertex lists coincide. (The two-hypothesis version is false — the development keeps a machine-checked counterexample; the third hypothesis is the repair, available for free at the sole use site.) It is now proved outright, with the statement byte-unchanged, in a dedicated 1,700-line module; the falsifier battery ran clean before the proof (8,000 randomized cases), the full build is green, and the axiom-census printout confirms every capstone footprint unchanged. The corpus carries zero banked statements.
nodes.note: This is the one item in this stage that IS machine-checked: Lean-core footprint, statement fence respected (only ':= by sorry' became a term-mode application of the new core theorem).
